subject: Trial roadmap & weekly digest — Optima Health POC
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Lee <simon.lee@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial roadmap & weekly digest — Optima Health POC

Hi Simon — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed trial (POC) plan so we have a shared playbook to move forward. I attached a short POC plan and a Mutual Action Plan spreadsheet.

Key goals you called out:
- Validate 95th percentile inference latency under your 512-token median prompt load (target < 220ms)
- Verify cost per 1k tokens for typical billing scenarios (compare baseline to Redwood batching + cache)
- Confirm shadowing/integration with your analytics pipeline (events + token-level timing)

Proposed success criteria (suggested for sign-off):
1) Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 220ms on the dedicated test pool for the core flows.
2) Cost: at least 30% token-cost reduction vs current hosted routing for same throughput.
3) Quality: responses pass your 10 prompt evaluation suite with parity to your current baseline (no more than 5% regression).
4) Integration: event stream to your analytics in place and test events received.

Timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize M.A.P., access & IAM, small onboarding handshake test
- Week 1: deploy trial model, run smoke tests, sample load runs
- Week 2–3: full evaluation runs, run your prompt suite, collect metrics
- Week 4: wrap-up, go/no-go, contract/procurement handoff if green

Owners (for clarity):
- Redwood POC lead: Vanessa Ortiz (me) — orchestration, config, liaison
- Redwood infra/ops: Rafael Mendes — capacity, dedicated pool setup, perf tuning
- Optima engineering lead: Emily Tran — IAM, integration, dataset for evals
- Optima procurement: procurement@optimahealth.com — commercial/contract steps

Next steps I suggest for this week:
1) You confirm the success criteria above (reply with any edits).
2) Emily to share a short sample prompt suite and access requirements (SAML or service account?).
3) Procurement to confirm billing contact and PO cadence (if procurement is ready, we can parallelize).

I’ll kick off the MAP and turn on the draft dedicated pool once we have access window. If that all looks good, can we lock a 30–60 minute tech kickoff for Monday morning (June 8) PST? I’ll include Rafael and Marissa.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-7382

Attachments: optima_poc_plan_v1.pdf; optima_mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Simon Lee <simon.lee@optimahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Tran <emily.tran@optimahealth.com>, procurement@optimahealth.com, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial roadmap & weekly digest — Optima Health POC

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side:

- Latency: our median prompt is ~400 tokens, 95th under 220ms is ambitious but aligns with our product goals. We may need to test both 256 and 512 token buckets as some flows are shorter.
- Cost reduction target: 30% is reasonable; procurement will also be evaluating per-inference spend vs savings on batching.
- Quality: we have an internal prompt suite (10 families) — Emily will share a CSV of prompts and expected pass criteria.

Questions:
1) For the dedicated pool, can you confirm GPU type and whether quantized variants will be used during the trial?
2) Do you support prefix caching across sessions for SDK-based calls?
3) Will you provide a dashboard with token-level cost breakdowns during the trial?

Procurement note: we prefer to run the technical trial in parallel with a provisional MSA signature or a short POC addendum to limit legal exposure. procurement@optimahealth.com — can you confirm the right contact for a provisional agreement?

Confirming: Monday June 8 at 9:30am PST for the tech kickoff works for Emily and me.

Simon
Director of Product | Optima Health
Simon.Lee@optimahealth.com | +1 (415) 222-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Lee <simon.lee@optimahealth.com>, Emily Tran <emily.tran@optimahealth.com>, procurement@optimahealth.com
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial roadmap & weekly digest — Optima Health POC

Perfect — thanks for the quick notes. Short answers:
- Dedicated pool: default config for the trial will be NVIDIA H100-equivalent instances (we’ll confirm exact SKU in the kickoff). Rafael will provision a quantized runtime option so we can A/B quantized vs full precision.
- Prefix caching: yes — we support prefix/KV caching for SDK calls; we’ll enable prefix caching for the flows you identify.
- Dashboard: yes — Redwood Console access will be provisioned (token-level cost, latency percentiles, per-route breakdown). We’ll add Emily as a viewer for the trial.

I’ll also send a brief Kanban-style weekly digest after each week’s run so we can keep momentum and surface blockers early.

Action items (I’ll track these in the MAP):
- Emily: share prompt suite CSV and access specs (target: today EOD).
- procurement@optimahealth.com: quick confirmation on provisional MSA contact.
- Rafael: provision trial pool + quantized runtime, ETA end of day Monday (6/8).
- Marissa: prepare a short success-metrics dashboard template for the kickoff.

Tech kickoff: Monday 2026-06-08 09:30 PST / 12:30 EST — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2026-06-14T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly digest — Optima Health POC (Week 1 status & next steps)

Team — quick weekly digest and a nudge on the outstanding items after our kickoff last week. Keeping this tight so Optima can move quickly.

This week (Week 1) status:
- Redwood infra: Rafael confirmed pool and deployed quantized runtime. Smoke tests passed against the sample prompts Rafael used (latency median ~120ms, 95th ~210ms on a synthetic run).
- Optima: Emily shared the prompt suite (10 families) and a test account for integration; procurement sent contact (Lisa Kim, lisa.kim@optimahealth.com) and is open to a provisional addendum.
- Dashboard: Marissa shared a draft dashboard template in the Drive link (see MAP).

Blockers / asks (please action asap):
1) Emily: we still need the final service account SAML assertion or service-account key for automated runs — can you send that today?
2) Lisa (procurement): can you confirm whether Optima requires an NDA addendum before we begin automated load runs? Procurement answer will determine when we can run scaled tests.
3) Rafael: please upload the trial pool SKU and cost-estimate to the MAP (we need a rough cost projection for procurement).

Planned next steps for Week 2:
- Run the full prompt suite across the trial pool and gather latency and token-cost stats.
- Export sample event stream to Optima analytics and validate event integrity.
- Weekly wrap: internal review on Friday and short results email to Optima with metrics and recommended tuning.

If we can close the three blockers above by tomorrow EOD, we’ll aim to kick off scaled runs on Wednesday. Rafael/Marissa — can you prioritize the cost estimate + dashboard updates? Emily/Lisa — scheduling depends on your access + procurement position.

I’ll post another digest mid-week if anything shifts.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
